description: This file contains functions for handling IPv4 addresses, including validation, conversion between dotted-quad and integer formats, network mask operations, and IP address classification checks such as RFC 1918, loopback, multicast, and link-local addresses. It also defines some IP address ranges for private and reserved IPv4 addresses.

methods.name: assert_uint32
methods.description: Validates if input is a decimal integer within 0 and 2^32-1 range.

methods.name: bitcount
methods.description: Calculates the number of bits set in a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: str2ip
methods.description: Converts a dotted-quad IP string to a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: ip2str
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit integer to a dotted-quad IP string.

methods.name: prefix2netmask
methods.description: Converts a prefix length to a subnet mask in integer form.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if the subnet mask bits are contiguous (valid netmask).

methods.name: netmask2prefix
methods.description: Converts a netmask in integer form to a prefix length after validation.

methods.name: is_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks whether an IP address is within RFC 1918 private address ranges.

methods.name: is_rfc3927
methods.description: Checks whether an IP address is an RFC 3927 link-local address.

methods.name: is_loopback
methods.description: Checks whether an IP address is a loopback address.

methods.name: is_multicast
methods.description: Checks whether an IP address is a multicast address.
